subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: What canonical model identity contract should OpenClaw expose for requested, selected/effective, and upstream-resolved provider/model/fallback state across session rows, `session_status`, and agent runtime context?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but naming and semantics affect the Gateway API shape, persisted session state, provider fallback behavior, UI/status wording, and compatibility with existing `modelProvider`/`model` consumers.

options.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
options.body: Add optional `resolvedProvider`, `resolvedModel`, and `fallbackUsed` style fields while preserving current `modelProvider` and `model` selected/effective behavior.

options.title: Clarify existing fields only
options.body: Document and tighten `modelProvider` and `model` as the effective runtime identity without adding a separate resolved-backend contract.

options.title: Split consumer surfaces
options.body: Keep this issue focused on session rows and `session_status`, while adjacent issues own HTTP headers, UI dropdown reconciliation, and provider-specific cost metadata.

recommendation.title: Add explicit resolved-runtime fields
recommendation.body: Add optional `resolvedProvider`, `resolvedModel`, and `fallbackUsed` style fields while preserving current `modelProvider` and `model` selected/effective behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the status surface and was already routed as the likely owner for the adjacent model-identity contract decision.
